subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: After an accepted Gateway run disconnects and bounded recovery cannot establish its terminal outcome, should `openclaw agent` preserve automatic isolated embedded fallback or fail closed unless the user explicitly opts into rerun?
rationale: Both options intentionally change the existing disconnect contract: one can re-execute effects, while the other can withhold an interactive result. The linked direction issue remains open and the branch description and docs currently describe different defaults.

options.title: Recover, then preserve automatic fallback
options.body: After bounded authoritative recovery fails, retain the current isolated `gateway-fallback-*` fallback so existing callers still receive a best-effort result.

options.title: Fail closed by default
options.body: Stop with the original run identifier after recovery exhaustion and require an explicit rerun option, accepting the new no-result behavior to avoid duplicate effects.

options.title: Defer the behavior change
options.body: Keep the merged fresh-session containment behavior and pause this broader recovery redesign until the product direction is decided.

recommendation.title: Recover, then preserve automatic fallback
recommendation.body: After bounded authoritative recovery fails, retain the current isolated `gateway-fallback-*` fallback so existing callers still receive a best-effort result.

likelyOwner.reason: The current fallback behavior originated in the merged containment change, making this the closest identified owner for the compatibility choice.
